title: The Stolen Thesis
logline: A researcher's life work on hyper-navigation has been stolen by their mentor, and they need proof to reclaim it.

roles.description: Brilliant but naive, desperate to save their career.
Arrogant, resting on past laurels, refuses to lose relevance.
An isolated outpost dedicated to theoretical physics.
The academic governing body, obsessed with prestige.

public_situation: A renowned scientist is about to publish a groundbreaking paper on navigation.
private_truth: The scientist stole the data from their protégé, altering the logs to make it look like their own work.

beats.public_change: The researcher gets locked out of the station network.

missions.reason: Needs a physical bypass key delivered to their private terminal.
missions.private_fact: The bypass key is highly illegal and could get them arrested.

beats.public_change: The mentor accelerates the publication schedule.

missions.reason: Needs someone to scan the primary data core and match the timestamps to the stolen work.
missions.private_fact: The core is rigged to alert the mentor if scanned by unauthorized personnel.

beats.public_change: The board convenes to review the data.

missions.reason: The mentor hires the pilot to deliver forged calibration data to override the scan.
missions.private_fact: The forged data will permanently erase the young researcher's original logs.

player_choice.prompt: The pilot must choose who to support.

options.label: Report the whole mess to the board

resolutions.reached_by: The mentor gets the forged data or the pilot fails.
resolutions.summary: The mentor publishes the paper. The young researcher is discredited and expelled.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot finds the evidence and refuses to help the mentor.
resolutions.summary: The forgery is exposed. The mentor is disgraced, and the young researcher gets the credit.
The board silences both of them to protect the university's reputation, taking the work for themselves.

loose_threads.detail: The university board received anonymous donations just before approving the fast-track publication.
Three months of early navigation logs are completely missing, not just altered.

radio_hooks: Academic scandal brewing over upcoming hyper-navigation paper.
University denies allegations of data theft.

voice_direction.young_researcher: Stressed, speaks quickly, constantly second-guessing themselves.
voice_direction.old_mentor: Smooth, practiced, projects absolute unearned confidence.
